stops.name: Foresta Demaniale di Paneveggio
stops.detail: To the north, defined by the slopes of Lagorai and those of the Cima Bocche group, the Travignolo stream valley hosts the Paneveggio State Forest, one of the most famous forest complexes in the Alps.

stops.name: Passo Rolle
stops.detail: The formation is well exposed northwest of Paneveggio, along some bends of the road between San Martino di Castrozza and Passo Rolle, along the valley from Passo Valles to Falcade.

stops.name: Malga Juribello
stops.detail: In the Park area the thicknesses of the sandstone layers are of limited power as are the outcrops of the Val Gardena sandstones. The main outcrops are on the southern slope of Passo Lusia, north of Malga Bocche, downstream of Malga Juribello.

days.title: Geological Wonders of the Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Val Canali
stops.detail: This formation has great variability, both horizontal and vertical with a thickness of a few hundred meters. It outcrops in Val Canali, but, above all, on the Costazza, Malga Juribello, Cima Valles and on the northern slope of Bellamonte.

stops.name: Val Venegia
stops.detail: Sedimentary rocks outcrop on the orographic left of the Cismon stream and in Val Venegia, while magmatic (or igneous) and metamorphic rocks from the Permian outcrop in the eastern area of the Lagorai chain, a mountain massif consisting of quartz porphyry, at Passo Rolle, Passo Valles, Colle Margherita as far as Falcade.
